traceability.evidence:
Implementation: - Rule source: src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts - ESLint RuleModule `require-branch-annotation` implemented. - Traceability: @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md with @req REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION and REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE. - meta: - type: "problem"; fixable: "code". - docs.description: "Require @story and @req annotations on code branches". - messages.missingAnnotation: "Branch is missing required annotation: {{missing}}." (clear which annotation is missing). - schema validates `branchTypes` option (array of strings, uniqueItems, additionalProperties: false). - create(context): - Uses validateBranchTypes(context) to either return a RuleListener (for invalid config) or an array of branch types. - Registers handlers for each configured branch type. For SwitchCase, skips default cases (`test == null`) as non-significant. - Calls reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef) for each branch node, enforcing @story/@req.
- Helper logic: src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts - DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES (REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA): - ["IfStatement", "SwitchCase", "TryStatement", "CatchClause", "ForStatement", "ForOfStatement", "ForInStatement", "WhileStatement", "DoWhileStatement"]. - Matches story requirement of significant branches (if/else, try/catch, switch, loops). - validateBranchTypes(context) (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE): - Reads `context.options[0].branchTypes`. - If provided and any values are not in DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES, returns { Program(node) { ... } } that reports: - `Value "${t}" should be equal to one of the allowed values: ${DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES.join(", ")}` for each invalid type. - If all provided values are valid, returns that list; otherwise returns a copy of DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES when no option is given. - gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node) (REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION): - For SwitchCase, scans up to PRE_COMMENT_OFFSET (2) lines above the case line while they start with // or /*, collecting comments (handles inline comments and blank-line edge cases). - For other nodes, uses sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node) and maps comment.value to reconstruct leading comment text. - getBranchAnnotationInfo(...) (REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING): - text = gatherBranchCommentText(...); missingStory = !/@story\b/.test(text); missingReq = !/@req\b/.test(text). - Derives indentation and insertPos from sourceCode and node.loc. - reportMissingStory(...) and reportMissingReq(...) (REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING + UX): - When missing @story and this is the first story fix, inserts `// @story .story.md\n` before the branch via a fixer. - When missing @req and @story is present, inserts `// @req \n` before the branch via a fixer. - Always report with messageId "missingAnnotation" and data { missing: "@story" or "@req" }. - reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef): - Uses getBranchAnnotationInfo(...) and then iterates actions (for @story and @req). For each missing, calls corresponding reporter. - Works for any branch node visited, including nested structures.
Documentation: - docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md - Describes rule purpose: "Ensures that significant code branches (if/else, switch cases, loops, try/catch) have `@story` and `@req` annotations for traceability." - Traceability annotations: - @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md - @req REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE. - Options section documents `branchTypes`: default and allowed values exactly match DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES. - Explains invalid config behavior: error message of the form `Value "InvalidType" should be equal to one of the allowed values.` - Provides correct/incorrect code examples and invalid configuration example, satisfying documentation acceptance criterion.
Integration into plugin and configs: - src/index.ts - RULE_NAMES includes "require-branch-annotation" so the rule is dynamically required via `require(./rules/${name})`. - TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES maps: - "traceability/require-branch-annotation": "error". - createTraceabilityFlatConfig() returns recommended/strict flat configs that include this rule at error severity. - configs.recommended and configs.strict therefore both enforce the branch rule, meeting integration criteria.
Tests (behavior, UX, error handling, configurable scope): - tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts - Header explicitly references this story: - Tests for: docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md - @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md - @req REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION etc. - describe: "Require Branch Annotation Rule (Story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS)". - Valid tests (REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION & REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE): - Branches with both @story and @req: - IfStatement, ForStatement (with block comments), WhileStatement, DoWhileStatement, ForOfStatement, ForInStatement. - SwitchCase examples including inline annotations and a fallback-scanning scenario with a blank line before the case. - Try/finally and try/catch with annotations. - Default switch case without annotations is allowed (significance decision implemented and tested). - Configurable scope: - Custom branchTypes ignoring unlisted types. - Custom branchTypes that enforce only listed types, e.g., ["IfStatement", "SwitchCase"]. - Invalid tests (Core functionality, UX, nested/complex structures, error handling): - Missing annotations on if-statement: expects two missingAnnotation errors (for "@story" and "@req") and autofix inserting `// @story .story.md`. - Missing @req when only @story present on for-loop: expects missingAnnotation for "@req" and fix inserting `// @req `. - Missing @story when only @req present on while-loop: expects missingAnnotation for "@story" and fix inserting `// @story .story.md`. - Missing annotations on switch-case (with and without blank lines before case): validates fallback scanning behavior and autofix placement. - Missing annotations on do-while, for-of, for-in, testing all loop types. - Missing annotations on try-catch blocks: expects multiple missingAnnotation errors covering both try and catch branches. - Configurable scope with ForStatement only: missing annotations produce errors and autofix, proving branchTypes control works. - Invalid configuration behavior: - Test "[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] invalid branchTypes option should error schema" uses options [{ branchTypes: ["UnknownType"] }] and expects an error message matching `/should be equal to one of the allowed values/`, validating validateBranchTypes and its Program handler.
- tests/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.test.ts - Validates: - validateBranchTypes returns default types when no options. - Returns custom list when valid types provided. - Returns a listener that reports configuration errors when invalid types are passed.
- Plugin/config integration tests: - tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts - Confirms plugin default export includes rules and configs. - Confirms rule names include "require-branch-annotation". - Confirms configs.recommended and configs.strict include correct rule configuration and severity mappings.
Test execution evidence: - Command executed: `npm test -- --runInBand --verbose`. - Jest output shows: - PASS tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts with all valid and invalid cases passing. - PASS tests/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.test.ts. - PASS tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts and other integration tests. - Overall summary: 36 test suites passed, 272 tests passed, 0 failed.
Mapping to story acceptance criteria: - Core Functionality: Rule detects missing @story/@req on all significant branch types specified, with tests verifying detection and autofix. - Quality Standards: ESLint best practices followed (meta, schema, option validation, no heavy operations). Implementation uses simple AST visitors and string checks, suitable for large files. - Integration: Rule registered in plugin, dynamically loaded, and included in recommended/strict flat-config presets; integration tests confirm this. - User Experience: Error message clearly indicates the missing annotation (via {{missing}}). Autofixes provide concrete placeholder annotations, guiding developers. - Error Handling: Handles invalid configuration via validateBranchTypes and Program listener; handles SwitchCase default and blank-line edge cases; nested branches are fully supported as visitors are bound to node types irrespective of nesting. - Documentation: docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md documents behavior, configuration, and examples tied to this story.
traceability.notes: All functional and non-functional aspects described in docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md are implemented and verified. The `require-branch-annotation` rule enforces @story and @req annotations on all specified branch types, supports configurable scope, provides clear and fixable error messages, integrates into the plugin’s recommended/strict flat configs, and is fully documented. Multiple targeted Jest test suites reference this story, cover valid/invalid branch patterns, configuration errors, and helpers, and all pass. This satisfies the story’s acceptance criteria and definition of done elements that are observable in the codebase, so the assessment status is PASSED.
